notes: Cash basis county; all funds governmental; same choices as FY2023. Statement receipts from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds (p4); Taxes 5,007,581 split with the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): property general 3,129,568 + property debt service 806,704 + motor vehicle 386,672 + inheritance 684,637 = 5,007,581. Charges for services 577,216 kept as printed (SoA: program charges 505,106 + other local receipts 72,110). Public Works 43,357 is the General Fund Noxious Weed department (43,523 less capital outlay 166; Surveyor nil). Transfers 400,000 (Inheritance Tax to General) print only in the fund columns of Exhibit D; the Total column prints none, so statement transfers are null (net zero). Nonmajor transfers 37,624 (911 Wireless to Central Communications) net to zero. Fund balance roll-forward 6,863,648 + 8,504,537 - 7,913,212 = 7,454,973. Ending cash = cash and CDs (printed combined) incl. restricted; no beginning cash printed. Balance sheet from Exhibit C Total column (equals the Statement of Net Position p1). Exhibit D heads the debt fund 'Hospital Bond Fund'; Exhibit C and Schedule 4 call it Debt Service Fund (detail uses Debt Service Fund). Detail: budget schedules General (pp5-10; General Fund receipts total includes Transfers 400,000), Road/Bridge (p11), Inheritance Tax (p12; disbursements total includes Transfer out 400,000), Debt Service (p13) and nonmajor funds by fund (pp14-16); the combining schedule (p17) is not recorded separately. Lines with no actual amount are omitted. 'Local' receipt lines kept as other (context label) with the combining/Exhibit D heading noted in review. 911 Wireless Service Holding Fund 2,812 is 'Transfers in' on Schedule 5 but Intergovernmental on the combining schedule (decision_needed). Read pages 1-17 of 17
